# LRF-IMU-HARTH agent guide

## PROJECT PURPOSE

This repository is research software for a class-conditioned latent Rectified
Flow generator of three-axis thigh accelerometer windows. The Paper 3 path
uses HARTH plus Adult Walking Speed under the `harth_walking_speed` composition.
The earlier REALDISP path remains documented separately.

## PIPELINE

HARTH-family data -> 160/40 windows -> training-only normalization -> VAE
latent `[48,40]` -> ten-class Rectified Flow -> VAE decode -> `[N,3,160]`
signals at 50 Hz.

Paper 3 application: DayForge evidence -> Module B mapping -> Module C exact-
duration generation -> stitching/fusion -> synthetic sensor timeline.

## IMPORTANT PATHS

- `src/lrf_imu/data/`: HARTH-family and legacy data preparation.
- `src/lrf_imu/models/`: VAE and Flow architectures.
- `src/lrf_imu/training/`: training loops and orchestration.
- `src/lrf_imu/evaluation/`: Module A sanity/evaluation.
- `src/lrf_imu/integration/physical_state.py`: Module B evidence mapping.
- `src/lrf_imu/integration/dayforge.py`: read-only DayForge/evidence adapter.
- `src/lrf_imu/integration/fusion.py`: existing Module C synthesis/stitching.
- `configs/paper/harth_10class_160_40.yaml`: frozen Paper 3 model contract.
- `configs/paper/dayforge_harth_mapping.yaml`: Module B mapping policy.
- `docs/`: methodology, architecture, reproducibility, and validation notes.

## TAXONOMY

IDs are fixed: 0 `walking_slow`, 1 `walking_moderate`, 2 `walking_brisk`,
3 `running`, 4 `stair_climbing`, 5 `cycling_seated`, 6 `cycling_standing`,
7 `sitting`, 8 `standing`, 9 `lying`. Do not add a sleep class.

## MODULE RESPONSIBILITIES

- Module A checks VAE/Flow geometry, finite values, reconstruction, latent and
  spectral diagnostics. It is descriptive sanity evaluation, not equivalence.
- Module B maps realized mobility and conservative DayForge evidence. It owns
  `physical_state_hint` and `in_bed_or_lying_opportunity` provenance.
- Module C already implements exact-duration generation, deterministic seeds,
  crop/stitch behavior, provenance, and failure audits. Do not reimplement it.

## PRODUCTION CHECKPOINTS

- VAE filename: `vae_s3_z48.pt`; SHA-256:
  `6B118182E14FF04CBD57D66A76986BF3568561F0FD42D02257F8036A0138AAD9`.
- Flow filename: `flow_unet_best.pt`; SHA-256:
  `F1058EB1FB94809B74B8DFFC24E2697F8C73B046CF2A8E7D24FFF60EC6D63164`.
- Scientific freeze: commit `150b4de6e58365fdda5fc7279192c136d4e8b064`,
  tag `paper3_lrf_dayforge_handoff_v1`.

## KEY COMMANDS

```text
python -m lrf_imu vae-smoke
python -m lrf_imu flow-smoke
python -m lrf_imu prepare-harth-data --data-root <root> --composition harth_walking_speed --held-out-subject harth:S006
python -m lrf_imu train-harth-vae --data-root <root> --composition harth_walking_speed --held-out-subject harth:S006 --config configs/paper/harth_10class_160_40.yaml --output-dir <output>
python -m lrf_imu train-harth-flow --data-root <root> --composition harth_walking_speed --held-out-subject harth:S006 --config configs/paper/harth_10class_160_40.yaml --vae-checkpoint <vae> --output-dir <output>
python -m lrf_imu evaluate-harth-vae --data-root <root> --composition harth_walking_speed --held-out-subject harth:S006 --config configs/paper/harth_10class_160_40.yaml --vae-checkpoint <vae> --output-dir <output>
python -m lrf_imu evaluate-harth-flow --data-root <root> --composition harth_walking_speed --held-out-subject harth:S006 --config configs/paper/harth_10class_160_40.yaml --vae-checkpoint <vae> --flow-checkpoint <flow> --output-dir <output>
python -m lrf_imu map-dayforge-physical-states --dayforge-root <dayforge> --derived-root <in-bed> --config configs/paper/dayforge_harth_mapping.yaml --output-dir <mapping>
python -m lrf_imu synthesize-dayforge --dayforge-root <dayforge> --mapping-root <mapping> --vae-checkpoint <vae> --flow-checkpoint <flow> --normalization-metadata <normalization> --output-dir <fusion> --persona <id> --date <date>
```

## TEST COMMANDS

```text
python -m pytest -p no:cacheprovider -q
python -m compileall -q src
git diff --check
python -m ruff check src tests
```

## REPRODUCIBILITY CONTRACT

Use seed 42 unless an experiment says otherwise. Preserve 50 Hz, three
channels, 160-sample windows, 40-sample hop, training-only normalization,
LOSO subject separation, exact `[start,end)` duration semantics, checkpoint
hashes, and source immutability. Same-seed output is expected to match only
under the tested runtime conditions; different devices/kernels may vary.

## DAYFORGE INTERFACE

DayForge is read-only input. `physical_state_hint` is optional contextual
evidence with values walking, running, cycling, stairs, sitting, standing,
lying, mixed, or unknown. `in_bed_or_lying_opportunity` is an additive,
sensor-facing opportunity and is not physiological sleep.

## SCIENTIFIC GUARDRAILS

- Do not casually change the ten-class HARTH taxonomy.
- Do not treat DayForge semantic activity as HARTH ground truth.
- Do not map passive transport to sitting solely because a person is seated.
- Do not infer walking speed from `physical_state_hint` alone.
- Do not infer cycling posture from a cycling hint alone.
- Do not treat `in_bed_or_lying_opportunity` as physiological sleep.
- Do not generate IMU for unavailable or non-realized mobility.
- Do not repeat one synthetic tile to fill a long interval.
- Preserve exact-duration `[start,end)` semantics.
- Do not modify VAE/Flow checkpoints during integration tasks.
- Do not optimize mapping coverage by weakening evidence rules.
- Module C stitching/fusion already exists.
